headline: Artist Documents Britain's Rewilding Revolution in Paint
meta_description: Painter Rebecca Howard has spent a year documenting nine UK rewilding projects, from beaver reintroduction to saltmarsh restoration, in a new exhibition at Kne…
summary_short: Artist Rebecca Howard captures Britain's rewilding transformation in a new exhibition celebrating nine conservation projects bringing nature back to life.
body:
Artist Rebecca Howard has spent the past year painting nine rewilding projects across Britain—from beaver reintroduction in Devon to wildflower meadows in Yorkshire—documenting landscapes where nature is making a remarkable comeback. Her exhibition, A Year in the Wild, runs until 18 October at Knepp, the Sussex estate renowned for its own rewilding success. Howard describes herself as being "in awe" of the land managers and conservationists she encountered, moved by how quickly ecosystems heal when given the chance. The works capture saltmarsh restoration in Lancashire, turtle dove conservation in Somerset, and the subtle beauty of decay transformed into new life—including a painting of a felled larch covered in porcelain mushrooms at Moor Barton in Devon.

Beyond the canvas, Howard's exhibition reveals something deeper: that Britain's wildlife crisis is not inevitable. She witnessed merlin hawks, species once impossible to see in many places, returning to restored habitats. These encounters speak to a larger truth—that ecological abundance is achievable through patient, deliberate work. Whether through species reintroduction or careful land management, the message is clear: abandoned or neglected land is resilient.

The exhibition carries real-world impact. Howard is selling prints and cards with proceeds supporting Rewilding Britain, turning artistic appreciation into conservation funding. Her year documenting these nine projects celebrates not just the landscapes transformed, but the determination of the people behind them. In painting these scenes of recovery, Howard has created a visual argument for what patience and intention can achieve—making visible the wilder Britain that's already emerging.
quick_facts: Exhibition runs until 18 October at Knepp, Sussex
Nine UK rewilding projects documented across landscapes
Beaver reintroduction in Devon, saltmarsh in Lancashire
Proceeds from cards and prints support Rewilding Britain
